methods.false_positive_traps: Hindsight pivots, terminal unconfirmed pivot
methods.invalidation_conditions: New close beyond defended swing; reference expiry
methods.name: Confirmed swings, HH/HL/LH/LL
methods.necessary_evidence: Closed OHLC; 2/2 confirmed pivots; two highs and lows
methods.provider_requirements: Official Binance selected klines/current data for price/bar fields; qualified remote pack required for broad execution; true specialists require separately qualified tape
methods.temporal_sequence: Pivot at k becomes known only at close k+r
methods.valid_interpretation: Confirmed ladder or protected high/low; structure near a consequential reference

methods.false_positive_traps: Wicks, mixing hierarchy, unqualified MSS
methods.name: BOS / CHoCH / MSS
methods.necessary_evidence: Preknown comparable swing; ladder; buffered close
methods.provider_requirements: Official Binance selected klines/current data for price/bar fields; qualified remote pack required for broad execution; true specialists require separately qualified tape
methods.temporal_sequence: Swing confirmation precedes break; MSS needs later qualified context
methods.valid_interpretation: First accepted buffered close through a pre-known comparable swing; opposing break suggests shift, displacement + prior context qualifies MSS trial

methods.false_positive_traps: Rolling extrema mistaken for significant levels
methods.name: Horizontal S/R, supply/demand
methods.necessary_evidence: Frozen bounds; distinct visits; original ATR and tick
methods.provider_requirements: Official Binance selected klines/current data for price/bar fields; qualified remote pack required for broad execution; true specialists require separately qualified tape
methods.temporal_sequence: Known reference before touch and response
methods.valid_interpretation: Separated pre-known visits, impulsive response, approach to still-valid area

methods.competing_explanations: Ordinary repeated highs; no actual stop orders observed
methods.false_positive_traps: Consecutive equal candles are not separated pivots
methods.name: EQH/EQL / inferred liquidity pool
methods.necessary_evidence: Two separated confirmed pivots, frozen tolerance and retreat
methods.provider_requirements: Official Binance selected klines/current data for price/bar fields; qualified remote pack required for broad execution; true specialists require separately qualified tape
methods.temporal_sequence: Second pivot confirmation establishes pool
methods.valid_interpretation: At least two separated confirmed pivots within frozen ATR/tick tolerance; revisit/sweep proximity

methods.false_positive_traps: OHLC intrabar sequence and stop-volume inference
methods.name: Liquidity sweep / reclaim
methods.necessary_evidence: Preknown boundary, excursion, reclaim, later response
methods.provider_requirements: Official Binance selected klines/current data for price/bar fields; qualified remote pack required for broad execution; true specialists require separately qualified tape
methods.temporal_sequence: Same original reference and chronologically later opposing attempt
methods.valid_interpretation: Excursion and ordered close back through same frozen boundary

methods.false_positive_traps: Hindsight best-candle selection; institutional intent
methods.name: Order Block (OB) candidate
methods.necessary_evidence: Predeclared 1–4 bar base; last opposite full candle; meaningful displacement and BOS
methods.provider_requirements: Official Binance selected klines/current data for price/bar fields; qualified remote pack required for broad execution; true specialists require separately qualified tape
methods.temporal_sequence: Birth only at later BOS completion
methods.valid_interpretation: Last opposite candle in a small predeclared base immediately preceding meaningful displacement + BOS; birth known **at BOS**, then unconsumed zone approach

methods.false_positive_traps: Inventing replacement boxes after outcome
methods.name: Breaker / role-flip
methods.necessary_evidence: Existing OB or valid zone, accepted breach, later other-side retest
methods.provider_requirements: Official Binance selected klines/current data for price/bar fields; qualified remote pack required for broad execution; true specialists require separately qualified tape
methods.temporal_sequence: Original zone birth before failure before retest
methods.valid_interpretation: Existing valid OB/reference **accepted through**, followed by later opposite-side approach/retest

methods.false_positive_traps: Gap geometry does not prove absent trades or future fill
methods.invalidation_conditions: Two buffered distal closes in trial model
methods.name: Fair Value Gap (FVG)
methods.necessary_evidence: Three closed bars with exact non-overlap; tick and optional ATR/displacement
methods.provider_requirements: Official Binance selected klines/current data for price/bar fields; qualified remote pack required for broad execution; true specialists require separately qualified tape
methods.temporal_sequence: Born at third close, later mitigation and accepted failure
methods.valid_interpretation: Bullish 3-bar **non-overlap** `L_t > H_(t-2)`, bearish `H_t < L_(t-2)`; middle displacement and min width qualify meaningful subclass

methods.competing_explanations: Original gap failure without inverse response
methods.false_positive_traps: Changed candle color is not inverse gap
methods.invalidation_conditions: Accepted close back across opposite gap edge
methods.name: Inverse FVG (iFVG)
methods.necessary_evidence: Existing FVG; two distal closes; subsequent other-side test
methods.provider_requirements: Official Binance selected klines/current data for price/bar fields; qualified remote pack required for broad execution; true specialists require separately qualified tape
methods.temporal_sequence: Original gap before accepted breach before later retest
methods.valid_interpretation: Previously established FVG accepted through distal edge, then later tested from other side

methods.false_positive_traps: Touch is not evidence of unfilled institutional orders
methods.name: Mitigation/zone revisits
methods.necessary_evidence: Preknown frozen zone; actual later bar overlap and response
methods.provider_requirements: Official Binance selected klines/current data for price/bar fields; qualified remote pack required for broad execution; true specialists require separately qualified tape
methods.temporal_sequence: Birth before visit; same original zone ID
methods.valid_interpretation: First/subsequent visits to a pre-known OB/FVG/S&D zone; penetration, response, accepted failure

methods.false_positive_traps: Fibonacci alone is not independent evidence
methods.name: OTE
methods.necessary_evidence: Frozen confirmed impulse plus independent zone; 62–79 percent trial band
methods.provider_requirements: Official Binance selected klines/current data for price/bar fields; qualified remote pack required for broad execution; true specialists require separately qualified tape
methods.roles: CONTEXT, targeted INITIATE only when independent structure
methods.temporal_sequence: Endpoints confirmed before retracement evaluation
methods.valid_interpretation: Frozen confirmed impulse `[A,B]`, price retraces trial `62%–79%` band **plus** real zone/structure

methods.false_positive_traps: Post-hoc candle selection; conflicting CRT variants
methods.name: Candle Range Theory (CRT) variant
methods.necessary_evidence: Reference candle explicitly selected before outcome; excursion/reclaim/initiative
methods.provider_requirements: Official Binance selected klines/current data for price/bar fields; qualified remote pack required for broad execution; true specialists require separately qualified tape
methods.temporal_sequence: Reference selection precedes later excursion
methods.valid_interpretation: **Preselected** completed 1H/4H reference candle `[L0,H0]`; later edge excursion, reclaim and structural initiative toward opposite reference

methods.false_positive_traps: Manipulation label is not intent
methods.name: PO3 / AMD prototype
methods.necessary_evidence: Predeclared session; balance then excursion/reclaim then opposing displacement
methods.provider_requirements: Official Binance selected klines/current data for price/bar fields; qualified remote pack required for broad execution; true specialists require separately qualified tape
methods.temporal_sequence: Session bounds known before excursion and later initiative
methods.valid_interpretation: Predeclared session balance → boundary excursion → reclaim → later opposing displacement/acceptance

methods.false_positive_traps: Assuming illustrative NY window is canonical
methods.name: Silver Bullet
methods.necessary_evidence: Primary-source window, timezone/DST and independent FVG/liquidity sequence
methods.provider_requirements: Official Binance selected klines/current data for price/bar fields; qualified remote pack required for broad execution; true specialists require separately qualified tape
methods.temporal_sequence: Verified window and local structure; no invented crypto schedule
methods.valid_interpretation: Credible primary-source time window + independent FVG/displacement/liquidity sequence, strict timezone/DST

methods.false_positive_traps: Invented Keepssy rules
methods.name: Keepssy Reversal Model
methods.necessary_evidence: Primary-source exact rules unavailable
methods.provider_requirements: Official Binance selected klines/current data for price/bar fields; qualified remote pack required for broad execution; true specialists require separately qualified tape
methods.temporal_sequence: Unspecified; no fabricated predicate
methods.valid_interpretation: None until primary-source exact rules supplied and reconciled

methods.false_positive_traps: Auction words mistaken for true value profile
methods.invalidation_conditions: Accepted out-of-range movement refutes old rotation
methods.name: Auction Market Theory
methods.necessary_evidence: Price-only balance references and causal acceptance/rejection; true value needs tape
methods.provider_requirements: Official Binance selected klines/current data for price/bar fields; qualified remote pack required for broad execution; true specialists require separately qualified tape
methods.temporal_sequence: Known balance before edge visit and response
methods.valid_interpretation: Balance/imbalance, value-edge test, acceptance/rejection, failed auction, price discovery, value migration

methods.competing_explanations: Price-only range or profile proxy explicitly labeled
methods.false_positive_traps: OHLC allocation cannot be true profile
methods.invalidation_conditions: Invalid/missing profile scope or superseding value
methods.name: Volume Profile POC/VAH/VAL
methods.necessary_evidence: Actual executed volume by traded price; venue, bins, full interval
methods.provider_requirements: Official Binance selected klines/current data for price/bar fields; qualified remote pack required for broad execution; true specialists require separately qualified tape
methods.temporal_sequence: Prior complete declared profile before later interaction
methods.valid_interpretation: Verified price-bin executed-volume distribution and zone approach; compare fixed complete sessions

methods.false_positive_traps: POC/VA table cannot prove nodes
methods.invalidation_conditions: Incomplete tape, changed scope, consumed naked reference
methods.name: HVN/LVN / naked POC
methods.necessary_evidence: True price-bin tape, smoothing, node/tie/separation convention
methods.provider_requirements: Official Binance selected klines/current data for price/bar fields; qualified remote pack required for broad execution; true specialists require separately qualified tape
methods.temporal_sequence: Node known before first future visit; fixed session
methods.valid_interpretation: Documented node extremum/local minima and first visit to pre-known unfinished reference

methods.false_positive_traps: HLC3 proxy or unknown vendor reset treated as exact
methods.name: Session/anchored VWAP
methods.necessary_evidence: Complete exact Q/V and predeclared whole-bar anchor
methods.provider_requirements: Official Binance selected klines/current data for price/bar fields; qualified remote pack required for broad execution; true specialists require separately qualified tape
methods.temporal_sequence: Anchor known before included interval in current implementation
methods.valid_interpretation: Valid anchor, later price/value extension/reclaim, value migration or rejection

methods.false_positive_traps: z alone does not imply normality or reversal
methods.invalidation_conditions: Accepted repricing away from old mean
methods.name: Statistical reversion
methods.necessary_evidence: Past-only residual distribution and compatible regime plus failed progress
methods.provider_requirements: Official Binance selected klines/current data for price/bar fields; qualified remote pack required for broad execution; true specialists require separately qualified tape
methods.roles: DISCRIMINATE, INITIATE only with conditional regime
methods.temporal_sequence: Baseline before extension before later return attempt
methods.valid_interpretation: Past-only distribution of residuals, excursion, later failed progress, space to actual value

methods.false_positive_traps: Bar delta is not footprint; candle color is not delta
methods.invalidation_conditions: Missing bars, reset, mismatch in venue or units
methods.name: Real trade-side delta/CVD
methods.necessary_evidence: Verified base/quote taker bars; complete same-anchor CVD; swings for divergence
methods.provider_requirements: Official Binance selected klines/current data for price/bar fields; qualified remote pack required for broad execution; true specialists require separately qualified tape
methods.roles: INITIATE on supported sources, DISCRIMINATE otherwise
methods.temporal_sequence: Closed taker bars and causal pivot availability
methods.valid_interpretation: Timed, anchored price-vs-flow divergence, initiative/resistance at pre-known reference

methods.false_positive_traps: Bar delta mistaken for footprint; infinite ratios
methods.invalidation_conditions: Partial bins or zero denominator without min-volume policy
methods.name: Footprint diagonal imbalance
methods.necessary_evidence: Complete price-bin executed buy/sell, adjacent-bin convention, min volume
methods.provider_requirements: Official Binance selected klines/current data for price/bar fields; qualified remote pack required for broad execution; true specialists require separately qualified tape
methods.roles: TARGETED, specialist INITIATE on supported instruments
methods.temporal_sequence: Declared fully observed tape interval before stacked imbalance
methods.valid_interpretation: Valid price-bin executed buy vs adjacent-bin executed sell ratio, declared min volume and ≥3 adjacent bins as **trial** stack

methods.false_positive_traps: Static wall or OI cannot prove absorption
methods.invalidation_conditions: Missing tape or sustained progress through reference

methods.necessary_evidence: Repeated executed aggression at level with limited progress and later response
methods.provider_requirements: Official Binance selected klines/current data for price/bar fields; qualified remote pack required for broad execution; true specialists require separately qualified tape
methods.temporal_sequence: Comparable tape attempts precede subsequent response
methods.valid_interpretation: Repeated aggressive executed activity near a level **with limited price progress**, adequate tape, later response

methods.false_positive_traps: Falling volume alone is not exhaustion
methods.invalidation_conditions: New aggressive expansion or inadequate history
methods.name: Aggression exhaustion
methods.necessary_evidence: Comparable repeated attempts with executed aggression and limited progress
methods.provider_requirements: Official Binance selected klines/current data for price/bar fields; qualified remote pack required for broad execution; true specialists require separately qualified tape
methods.temporal_sequence: Observed attempts and declining flow before consequence
methods.valid_interpretation: Declining price progress and aggressive flow across comparable repeated attempts under valid tape history

methods.competing_explanations: Normal displayed liquidity; no spoof intent

methods.temporal_sequence: Current quote timestamp; no historical wall claim
methods.valid_interpretation: Current displayed depth within stated bps, imbalance, spread/wall appearance/removal if time series complete

methods.temporal_sequence: Comparable timestamps and units before delta
methods.valid_interpretation: Native/unit-aligned ΔOI with price, funding and actual structure

methods.false_positive_traps: Modeled maps mistaken for observed executions
